title: Task 5: Deepen Environment Targeting and Placement
intent: Add typed environment and deployment-unit targeting while preserving legacy runtime_config readers.
scope: Environment targeting owns default unit key, failure-domain labels, secret scope mode, and default reconcile mode.
Deployment units own runtime type, endpoint ref, Compose dir, namespace, network profile, ownership mode, and reconcile override.
Service/environment placement is carried by deployment_unit_id where placement rows already support it.
Nostr projections expose additive unit tags for 31961, 31963, 31967, and 31968.
